title: Israel Ben Yehuda Examines Ancient Biblical Fractures and Modern Geopolitical Crises in New Memoir ‘A Kingdom Divided’ Published by Contento Now | Publisher: Netanel Semrik | Israel Ben Yehuda
description: Israel - September 15, 2026 - Exploring the profound resonance of a name that bridges ancient history and modern destiny, A Kingdom Divided: Israel and Judah - A Wake-Up Call from the Heart of the Storm presents a gripping epic of resilience, faith, and historical continuity.

title: Why sex is forbidden on Yom Kippur, Judaism’s surprising ancient day of love and renewal
description: Jewish sources describe Yom Kippur as one of the year’s happiest days, when young people once sought partners; its ban on sexual intimacy, the authors argue, offers couples a lesson about repairing the heart before returning to the body

title: Chinese scientists find first evidence of ancient nose-chopping punishment for cattle thieves
description: Stealing someone’s cattle is a serious crime, and in many places, the thief would end up in jail. However, ancient Chinese justice could result in a truly horrific form of mutilation: the amputation of the nose. This harsh consequence has been well-documented by historians as one of the infamous “five punishments” from the penal system of the Xia dynasty (2070 BC–1600 BC). Until now, no physical evidence of this punishment had been discovered. A team of researchers from China and the US recently...

title: T. Rex Ran Hot as an Elephant, Fossil Tooth Study From LA's Thomas Reveals
description: UCLA scientists tested teeth from LA's Thomas the T. rex and found a 97.3-degree body temperature, confirming the predator was warm-blooded.

title: Fear Stops the Journey: Odisha’s Hill Roads Guarded by Ancient Goddesses
description: #ର ାସ୍ତାରେ_ଭୟ_ଅଟକାଉଛି_ଠାକୁରାଣୀ! ରାଜ୍ୟର ଦୁଇ ଜିଲ୍ଲାରେ ରହିଛି ଏମିତି ଦୁଇ ଦେବୀପୀଠ, ଯାହାକୁ ନେଇ ରହିଛି ଅନେକ ବର୍ଷର ବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଓ ପରମ୍ପରା। ଘାଟି ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଯାଉଥିବା ଲୋକେ ମାଆଙ୍କୁ ଡାଳ ଖଣ୍ଡେ ଅର୍ପଣ କରି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତି ଯାତ୍ରା। ବିଶ୍ୱାସ ରହିଛି, ମାଆଙ୍କ ଆଶୀର୍ବାଦ ନେଇ ଗଲେ ଯାତ୍ରା ହୁଏ ଶୁଭ ଓ ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ। ଖଲ୍ଲିକୋଟର ମାଆ ଡାଳଖାଇ ଓ ମୟୂରଭଞ୍ଜର ମାଆ ବଡ଼ାମ ବୁଢ଼ିଙ୍କୁ ନେଇ ଏହି ଅଲିଖିତ ପରମ୍ପରାର କାହାଣୀ। In Odisha, two ancient shrines along dangerous ghat roads are deeply rooted in faith and tradition. Travellers passing through these routes offer a small piece of wood to Maa Dalakhai in Khallikote and Maa Badam Budhi in Mayurbhanj before beginning their journey. Devotees believe seeking the goddesses’ blessings brings safety and good fortune on the road.
